claims.A4: A sys.meta_path alias finder whose loader returns the real module object gives identical module and class objects under aminx.* and molxmpnn.* names, while aliasing only the package in sys.modules yields duplicate module objects.

prereg.question: Does the transitional aminx shim need an alias finder (not just a sys.modules package alias) to keep module/class identity, isinstance and pickle behaviour intact, and does the finder also let a removed submodule (aminx.ebm) raise an informative error?
prereg.expect_if_true: A_module_identity, A_class_identity, A_isinstance_cross, A_real_spec_name_intact, A_pickle_records_real_path, A_pickle_loads, A_gone_module_raises are all true and A_deprecation_warning_count is 1, while B_module_identity, B_class_identity and B_isinstance_cross are all false (duplicate objects), which is the negative control proving the naive approach is not enough.
prereg.expect_if_false: Any A_* identity flag is false (the finder approach is unsound and the shim must be a full re-export copy), or any B_* flag is true (the naive alias is sufficient and the finder is unnecessary complexity).
